# LFM3-VL configuration fixture

`config.json` is metadata from Liquid AI's LFM3-VL-2B checkpoint, retrieved on
2026-10-31. No model weights are included.

Source: https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B/blob/main/config.json

Checkpoint license: LFM Open License v1.0
https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B/blob/main/LICENSE

`processor_config.json` is the matching processor metadata. `image_oracle.json`
contains deterministic preprocessing hashes generated by
`tool/vision_image_oracle.py`; it records the pinned source and Python runtime
versions. Inputs are synthetic RGB patterns defined in the script and test.
No user images or model weights are included.
